name: Binpack Opt Variant 5
task:
Please complete the following four-stage bin packing task.

=== Stage 1: Problem Setup ===
Pack 11 items into bins of capacity 50. Item sizes: [20, 15, 25, 18, 30, 12, 22, 28, 16, 35, 10].

=== Stage 2: Greedy Packing ===
Apply first-fit decreasing.

=== Stage 3: Improvement ===
Swap items between bins.

=== Stage 4: Verification ===
Compare with lower bound.
